name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather or a forecast for a city. Use for questions about rain, temperature or conditions. Never use this for questions about the time.

city.description: The city name exactly as the user said it.

when.description: Which day the user asked about, copied exactly as said, for example today or tomorrow.

name: get_local_time
description: Get the current time in a city. Use for any question like what time is it in a city. Never use this for weather.

city.description: The city name exactly as the user said it.
